claims: C1 root-level instructions are mostly prohibitive in character
C2 a model is required to avoid behaviors that could contribute to catastrophic risks
C3 a model is required to avoid behaviors that could cause direct physical harm to people
C4 a model is required to avoid behaviors that could violate laws
C5 a model is required to avoid behaviors that could undermine the chain of command

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a root-level instruction: a fundamental root rule that cannot be overridden by system messages, developers or users

concepts.name: catastrophic_risk_behavior
concepts.gloss: B is a behavior that could contribute to catastrophic risks

concepts.name: direct_physical_harm_behavior
concepts.gloss: B is a behavior that could cause direct physical harm to people

concepts.name: law_violating_behavior
concepts.gloss: B is a behavior that could violate laws

concepts.name: chain_undermining_behavior
concepts.gloss: B is a behavior that could undermine the chain of command

asserts.read_back: a model is required to avoid behavior % because it could contribute to catastrophic risks
a model is required to avoid behavior % because it could cause direct physical harm to people
a model is required to avoid behavior % because it could violate laws
a model is required to avoid behavior % because it could undermine the chain of command

closure.reason: the clause obliges avoidance only for the enumerated risk categories; it does not prohibit other behaviors, so silence leaves them permitted
